arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 175 python3 - << 'EOF'
import base64, io, csv, json, random, sys, time, ipaddress, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps')
import zstandard as zstd
rng = random.Random(9)
leases = [{'id': f'L{i:04d}', 'prefix': f'2001:db8:{(i>>8)&0xff:x}:{(i&0xff):x}00::/56',
           'start': 0, 'end': 100, 'subnets': [0], 'low_count': 32} for i in range(1985)]
HDR = ['type','id','revision','published','op','lease','event','probe','target','responder','result','service','attempt','payload']
buf = io.StringIO(newline=''); w = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator='\n'); w.writerow(HDR)
targets = []
for k in range(4096):
    li = k % 1985
    net = ipaddress.IPv6Network(leases[li]['prefix'], strict=True)
    n = (k % 32) + 1
    tgt = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(int(net.network_address) + n))
    targets.append(tgt)
    w.writerow(['icmp', f'e{k}', '0', '2', 'put', leases[li]['id'], '2', f'0/i{n}', tgt, tgt, 'echo', '', '', ''])
for k in range(195000):
    li = k % 100
    net = ipaddress.IPv6Network(leases[li]['prefix'], strict=True)
    n = (k % 32) + 1
    tgt = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(int(net.network_address) + n))
    w.writerow(['icmp', f'x{k}', str(k % 5), str(k % 20), 'put', leases[li]['id'], str(k % 20),
                f'0/i{n}', tgt, tgt, 'echo', '', '', ''])
data = buf.getvalue().encode()
comp = zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True).compress(data)
b64e = lambda x: base64.b64encode(x).decode()
requests = [{'id': f'R{k:04d}', 'at': 10, 'lease': f'L{(k % 1985):04d}', 'target': targets[k],
             'service': 'W', 'group': f'q{k % 4}'} for k in range(4096)]
offers = []
for j in range(8192):
    listing = sorted({f'R{k:04d}' for k in range(j % 32, 4096, 32)})[:32]
    offers.append({'id': f'O{j:04d}', 'time': 15, 'service': 'W',
                   'prefix': '2001:db8::/32',
                   'capacity': 8, 'cost': rng.randrange(0, 10**9),
                   'group': f'p{j % 4}', 'requests': listing})
job = {'version': 3, 'seed': 'sd', 'leases': leases,
       'services': [{'id': 'W', 'kind': 'tcp'}], 'queries': [10],
       'captures': [{'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': [b64e(comp[i:i+2000000]) for i in range(0, len(comp), 2000000)]}],
       'requests': requests, 'offers': offers,
       'request_quotas': [{'id': f'q{i}', 'parent': None if i == 0 else 'q0', 'capacity': 4096} for i in range(4)],
       'offer_quotas': [{'id': f'p{i}', 'parent': None if i == 0 else 'p0', 'capacity': 4096} for i in range(4)]}
raw = json.dumps(job).encode()
print('input bytes', len(raw))
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],
                   input=raw, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/tmp')
dt = time.time() - t
print('exit', p.returncode, 'stderr', p.stderr[:200])
res = json.loads(p.stdout)
print(f'runtime {dt:.1f}s resolved={res["plan"]["resolved"]} cost={res["plan"]["cost"]} '
      f'active={sum(1 for a in res["active_requests"] if a["active"])} stdout={len(p.stdout)}')
EOF
